description: This file implements the GLES1State class, which manages and tracks the state for GLES1 contexts, including matrix stacks, rendering parameters, and various OpenGL states.

classes.name: GLES1State
classes.description: Manages the state for GLES1 contexts, including matrix stacks, rendering states, and parameters.

classes.name: TextureCoordF
classes.description: Represents texture coordinates with four float components.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the GLES1State with context and state, setting default values.

methods.name: setAlphaFunc
methods.description: Sets the alpha test function and reference value.

methods.name: setClientTextureUnit
methods.description: Sets the active client texture unit.

methods.name: getClientTextureUnit
methods.description: Returns the current client texture unit.

methods.name: setCurrentColor
methods.description: Sets the current color.

methods.name: getCurrentColor
methods.description: Returns the current color.

methods.name: setCurrentNormal
methods.description: Sets the current normal vector.

methods.name: getCurrentNormal
methods.description: Returns the current normal vector.

methods.name: setCurrentTextureCoords
methods.description: Sets current texture coordinates for a specified unit.

methods.name: getCurrentTextureCoords
methods.description: Gets current texture coordinates for a specified unit.

methods.name: setMatrixMode
methods.description: Sets the current matrix mode (modelview, projection, texture).

methods.name: getMatrixMode
methods.description: Returns the current matrix mode.

methods.name: getCurrentMatrixStackDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the specified matrix stack.

methods.name: pushMatrix
methods.description: Pushes the current matrix onto the stack.

methods.name: popMatrix
methods.description: Pops the top matrix from the stack.

methods.name: loadMatrix
methods.description: Loads a new matrix into the current stack.

methods.name: multMatrix
methods.description: Multiplies the current matrix by another matrix.

methods.name: setLogicOp
methods.description: Sets the logical operation mode.

methods.name: setClientStateEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables client vertex array states.

methods.name: setTexCoordArrayEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables texture coordinate array for a specific unit.

methods.name: isClientStateEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a client state is enabled.

methods.name: isTexCoordArrayEnabled
methods.description: Checks if texture coordinate array is enabled for a specific unit.

methods.name: isTextureTargetEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a texture target is enabled for a specific unit.

methods.name: lightModelParameters
methods.description: Returns modifiable or const reference to light model parameters.

methods.name: lightParameters
methods.description: Returns modifiable or const reference to individual light source parameters.

methods.name: materialParameters
methods.description: Returns modifiable or const reference to material parameters.

methods.name: isColorMaterialEnabled
methods.description: Checks if color material mode is enabled.

methods.name: setShadeModel
methods.description: Sets the shading model.

methods.name: setClipPlane
methods.description: Sets the equation for a clip plane.

methods.name: getClipPlane
methods.description: Retrieves the equation for a clip plane.

methods.name: fogParameters
methods.description: Returns modifiable or const reference to fog parameters.

methods.name: textureEnvironment
methods.description: Returns modifiable or const reference to texture environment parameters for a unit.

methods.name: pointParameters
methods.description: Returns modifiable or const reference to point parameters.

methods.name: getVertexArraysAttributeMask
methods.description: Returns attribute mask for enabled vertex arrays.

methods.name: getActiveAttributesMask
methods.description: Returns mask of active attributes (always 8).

methods.name: setHint
methods.description: Sets various hint settings (e.g., perspective correction, point smooth).

methods.name: getHint
methods.description: Retrieves current hint setting for a target.

methods.name: setDirty
methods.description: Marks a specific state as dirty.

methods.name: setAllDirty
methods.description: Marks all states as dirty.

methods.name: clearDirty
methods.description: Clears all dirty flags.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if a specific state is marked dirty.
